description: This file contains function prototypes and macros related to the Broadway Web Resource Manager's Page Manager Object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal functions.

methods.name: BwrmCreatePageManager
methods.description: Creates a new Page Manager object for the Broadway Web Resource Manager.

methods.name: BwrmPmoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Page Manager Object instance.

methods.name: BwrmPmoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Page Manager Object instance.

methods.name: BwrmPmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols necessary subordinate objects for the Page Manager.
